think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range from PostgreSQL docs. 2) Check whether it has sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/enable special behavior) rather than just ‘smaller/larger’. 3) If such a sentinel exists and changes semantics (not merely the threshold), classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s).
